summary: One page now shows what is delegated and what is not across every workload, and Defender XDR roles are managed end to end.

new.title: Coverage & gaps page
new.text: Reviews & controls > Coverage & gaps shows what is covered and what is a gap across Entra ID, Intune, Defender XDR, Power BI and Azure, with ready proposals to stage.

new.title: Defender XDR roles managed for you
new.text: PIM Manager creates Defender XDR custom roles named like their group, corrects their permissions and assigns them with the right data sources.

new.title: Workload readiness at a glance
new.text: Template cards, wizards and Coverage & gaps show a green, amber or red chip for each workload's prerequisites, with the step to take.

new.title: Managed tenant registry and overview
new.text: On the managing tenant you register and edit managed tenants on a page, and a replication overview shows exactly what each tenant receives.

new.title: Smaller improvements
new.text: Policy templates page, all three policy types in every wizard, a new Intune template, Defender and Intune discovery, and warnings for groups missing their workload role.

fixes.title: Azure permission groups are created
fixes.text: Groups made by the Azure wizards were never created in the tenant. The group and its assignment are now added together.

fixes.title: Not checked is never in sync
fixes.text: Drift now shows an area that was skipped or could not be read as not checked, with the reason, instead of counting it as in sync.

fixes.title: Your naming convention everywhere
fixes.text: Discovered resources, template imports and retired groups now follow your own group naming pattern.

fixes.title: Defender XDR discovery works
fixes.text: Defender XDR roles are read correctly, and a failed read shows as a failed job instead of no roles.

fixes.title: Replication preview matches for admins
fixes.text: An admin without a management mode stays on the managing tenant and is shown that way in the preview.
